name: Tales of Ember
summary: Tales of Ember is a free-to-play digital collectible card game built around 30-card singleton decks, with no duplicate cards. Players choose from fifteen heroes across five factions, including ten heroes that combine two factions. Modes include a weekly ranked ladder, Ember Draft, campaign puzzles and tournaments. Cross-play uses one account across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS, with access currently available through the playtest. Its card mechanics and statistics derive from OpenSky, the open-source release of Skyweaver
